_note: Story-state facts for THE LAST SIGNAL. continuity_check.py votes on each (3 frames per shot). Add a rule whenever a viewer is confused. Rule ranges re-pointed to the final cut ids 2026-10-31 (strobe ids c16_NN_*).

rules.question: Is there any legible text, lettering or numbers painted or printed anywhere in this frame?
rules._note: the title card is excluded: its text is the point

rules.question: Is the sky in this frame a clear blue daytime sky?
Is the ground in this frame green grass, a road, or pale yellow desert sand?
Does the spaceship or vehicle in this frame look small, like a fighter jet, car or small shuttle?
Is the main person in this frame a woman?
Is the main person in this frame a man?
Are two people visible together in this frame?
Are the stone monoliths in this frame glowing with bright teal light?
Are carved stone monoliths in this frame glowing with teal light?
Is any person in this frame smiling or laughing?
